physarum_trace_gallery.name: A mark left behind
physarum_trace_gallery.description: The existing 300-agent Physarum table, a six-metre wall and a 1.2m hand surface share one colony. Carry the point and hold its action to deposit a trace.
physarum_trace_gallery.qfep_connection: A hand leaves a mark that later bodies can sense. Its persistence depends on deposition, diffusion and decay, not on its author remaining present.
